description: An oil-painted laboratory scene in warm brown tones. A weathered, older hand holds a pale sheet with rows of dark, short rod-like marks, which look like chromosomes. Behind it stand a brass-and-black compound microscope and, on the wooden bench, a glass petri dish with cultured material, a small amber dropper bottle, and a clear glass jar. A corner shows forceps on a cloth. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text or border.
